entries.title: Figure 3- Reasons for HUBZone Decertifications for Firms That Applied in Fiscal Years 2010–2013 (16448155079).jpg
entries.description: This image is excerpted from a U.S. GAO report: www.gao.gov/products/GAO-15-234 SMALL BUSINESS CONTRACTING: Opportunities Exist to Further Improve HUBZone Oversight a) This category includes 18 cases in which firms were decertified solely because they did not meet the requirement for employee residency and another 4 that were not small businesses. b) This category includes 144 cases that did not have any reason listed, and 5 "others" that a review of the comment fields revealed were mostly no longer in business. c) In 278 cases, we derived these reasons from the comment notes because the reason for the decertification was coded as "other." d) In addition to the 174 cases that only listed principal office as the reason, this category includes the 415 cases in which a voluntary decertification was listed as a second reason in the comments field that we reviewed and another 6 cases in which not meeting the employee eligibility requirement was indicated as a second reason.
entries.creator: U.S. Government Accountability Office from Washington, DC, United States

entries.title: Grant E., Hamilton, Their New Jerusalem, 1892 Cornell CUL PJM 1111 01.jpg
entries.description: "Their New Jerusalem". 1892 cartoon from Judge magazine , showing Jewish people driven from Russia by persecution, coming to New York City in rags and becoming prosperous due to their "Perseverance and Industry". Meanwhile, descendants of the city's "First Families" (Dutch settlers, "Schuyler", "Stuyvesant") head to the American West for new opportunities.
entries.creator: Grant E. Hamilton (d. 1926)
